nodes.label: W-256 — Phase 1 closed at 41 of 41
nodes.rationale: The annex had never been written back and still marked OPEN sixteen rows the ledger had disposed days earlier: 22 DONE, 9 CLOSED as unverifiable here under E-075 and CLAUDE.md §5, 10 carried to Phase 3.

nodes.label: Register 1854 — the unprinted-input class
nodes.rationale: §22.2.1's ablation table is right and unverifiable: its three directional figures are mutually consistent at full precision and not one reproduces from the two-figure inputs beside it. Solving the table's own ratios recovers the missing inputs, which print back as the figures already shown.

nodes.label: Register 1855 — the corpus practises truncation and names half-to-even once
nodes.rationale: 98 is unreachable under round-to-nearest — three shares each within a half of true sum to within one and a half of 100 — while truncation reaches it; and 0.14/0.008 = 17.5 rounds to 18 and truncates to the printed 17. The single site naming a convention is a Register correction saying 'rounding half to even', which matters to arith.py, scoring under HALF_UP and HALF_EVEN and returning neither site.

nodes.label: Register 1856 — a table printing its own formula and two values it does not give
nodes.rationale: n = 4 and n = 5 are exact to seven places, which identifies the formula beyond doubt, and n = 6 and n = 7 are not. Nothing is reconstructed: the volume is checked against the formula it prints on the line above. The law survives; two numerals and the word 'four' do not.

nodes.label: Register 1857 — eight constraints counted where Λ has seven
nodes.rationale: The constraint graph is eight nodes and seven edges — a tree, which requires exactly n − 1 — and the seven rebuild Λ₈ at 976 cells identical to the seated tower. 487's measurement is untouched: the same result at seven as at eight.

nodes.label: An instrument is validated against the volumes, not against itself
nodes.rationale: The lesson W-254 paid for: every figure either quotes a printed line or is solved from printed figures and shown to print back as what stands beside it.
